title: Surveying the Landscape of Image Captioning Evaluation: A Comprehensive Taxonomy, Trends and Metrics Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: The paper surveys existing metrics that quantify gender bias in image captioning, such as calculating the amplification of gender-activity correlations (e.g., "female-cooking"), counting gender-misclassified words compared to image labels (Gender error), and calculating the ratio of male to female candidate sentences (Gender ratio).

The paper surveys metrics that evaluate general bias amplification by training secondary models to predict protected demographic attributes given a generated caption or image-caption pair, and then computing the difference in prediction accuracies when training on model-generated candidates versus human-generated references.
